spec.name: sprint36_taker_imbalance_crypto_scalp
spec.hypothesis: Aggressor (taker) buy/sell volume imbalance over a short rolling window predicts next-15min directional drift in BTCUSD/ETHUSD, tradeable net of crypto taker fees.
spec.power_argument: Target n>=300: 2 symbols x ~15 entries/day (top/bottom imbalance decile trigger) x ~10 trading days = ~300 trades. At n=300 with assumed 15min-return vol ~45bps, SE~2.6bps; can detect edges down to ~6-8bps at conventional power. Crypto T2 round-trip friction ~15-20bps, so decision threshold is net edge > 20bps -- large enough to be economically meaningful, small enough to be falsifiable (exp14 lesson: this can fail under the null).
